name: ryu.bitwarden
description: Pull API keys from Bitwarden Secrets Manager on demand instead of storing them in plaintext — one machine-account bootstrap token (BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN) replaces N provider keys, and rotating a credential is one change in the Bitwarden web app. Declarative `command` tools that shell out to the locally-installed `bws` CLI (BYO binary, no API key in the manifest).
